integrity.statement: The proof is algebraic and self-contained. All computational claims refer to provided Python 3 standard-library programs and captured outputs. The scientific review was same-model only; no independent scientific audit has been performed.

limitations: Characteristic-two finite fields, dyadic cycles of length at least eight, clique factors of size at least three, and the stated linear two-row reversible update only. No spatial-automorphism quotient. Finite checks do not replace symbolic proof. Related historical literature may be unindexed.
title: Clique-parity bifurcation of reversible waves on dyadic cylinders
